criteria.name: Artwork craft & genuine detail
criteria.notes: This round lifted art from 6.5 to 7.0. S06's fur-like hachure is gone. It's now a hillshade with contours, a marching-squares coast, flat water and haloed labels, and it reads as relief at thumb. S08's static slab is now a modelled channel: lit ledge, board-formed riser with tie holes, a perspective floor, and a cylinder rail with collars and notches. S04 gains a lit oblique housing top, a bevelled breaker lip and closed flanges. S09 has a continuous hull and sits clear of the tag. S05 is still genuine masterful depth, S03 is good macro craft, and 01 and 09 climb the GPU ladder. Still charged: (1) S06 is soft and smeary. machine_qa reports a 361x325 per-pixel layer drawn up 6x across 72% of the canvas. The relief has a uniform worm-like bump scale that reads as crumpled clay more than an island, land fills nearly every pixel, and the Narrows and Sound never read as distinct water bodies. (2) S08's lower 40% is a large, mostly empty CG floor. The rail notches are faint: machine_qa says 12 of 14 declared marks carry no more ink than the band's texture, and the November 30th and December 1st ticks double up. The top half is still a mono table. (3) The S04 stack and drum still read as striped columns, the floor carries a dashed 'rain' texture that reads as noise, and the housing top plane is a thin sliver. (4) S02 is still flat fills. Two frames with dead or default regions keep this at the 7 descriptor, not above it.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The hillshade is a 361x325 layer upsampled 6x (machine_qa), so the whole relief is soft and smeary. Its bump scale is uniform and worm-like, so it reads as crumpled clay rather than an island. Land fills almost the entire frame, and Wrangell Narrows and Frederick Sound don't read as water bodies, so the geography the kicker names isn't visible.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Render the shade at the destination backing 1:1 with a cubic DEM sampler (AKS.cubicSampler), and apply a slope-dependent ambient term so ridges carry scale. Open the water mask so the Narrows reads as a continuous dark channel south from the town light, and label it.

The top half is still a pure mono table.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Cut the notches deeper and brighter (lit lower lip, dark upper shadow) so every declared month reads at thumb, drop the redundant December tick, and raise the rail and channel by about 150 px so the floor shrinks to a lit strip with a visible light pool under the gold span's start.
